M-REACTIVITY-ANALYZER.Purpose: Static analysis stage of the widget generator: extract widget declarations and Build method bodies from the AST, infer reactivity flags, and report diagnostic rules including FV0001.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Roslyn extraction of widget partial classes, properties and Build bodies.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Reactivity flag inference per property usage.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Diagnostic rule evaluation and reporting (FV0001 and siblings).
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Interprocedural parameter data flow, delegate invocation, static helpers, virtual dispatch, base calls, calls through other receivers and helpers outside the analyzed declaring type.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Source text emission — owned by M-WIDGET-EMITTER.

Requirements.REQ-001: Reactivity inference starts at locally declared BuildRenderTree and MeasureFunc and identifies instance properties declared on the analyzed class by Roslyn symbol identity.
Requirements.REQ-002: Invalid reactive usage reports FV0001 with a location pointing at the offending syntax.
Requirements.REQ-003: Valid widget declarations produce zero FV* diagnostics.
Requirements.REQ-004: PropertyExtractor resolves the original declaration through overridden symbols and records its containing type as SlotOwner.
Requirements.REQ-005: Analysis follows source-defined non-static, non-virtual, non-override methods and getters on the same declaring type through implicit or explicit this receivers, and directly called non-static local functions. Traversal has no depth limit and visits each symbol once per entry point to terminate recursive chains.
Requirements.REQ-006: BuildRenderTree property references infer ReconcileOnSet; direct Value member reads additionally infer ReconcileOnUpdate. MeasureFunc property references infer MarkDirtyOnSet and MarkDirtyOnUpdate. Explicit attribute arguments override inferred defaults.
Requirements.REQ-007: Construction analysis skips anonymous function bodies and uncalled local function declarations. Measurement analysis includes the entry property's first-level anonymous function bodies and skips nested anonymous functions; helper bodies retain the measurement context.
Requirements.REQ-008: All branches of a visited body contribute dependencies without execution-path feasibility or alias analysis. Dependencies outside the supported traversal require explicit attribute flags.

Inputs.IN-001: compilation/partial classes: Roslyn syntax and semantic models.

Outputs.OUT-001: widget models: schema owned by M-WIDGET-MODELS.
Outputs.OUT-002: diagnostics: FV0001 for invalid Widget declarations.
